Meaning of Sayyiduna - Islamic Dictionary. Sayyiduna is an honorific title meaning "Our Master" or "Our Leader." It is used as a mark of deep respect before the names of the Prophets, particularly Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), as well as the Archangels and prominent companions of the Prophet. While the term "Sayyid" can be a common surname or a title for descendants of the Prophet, "Sayyiduna" is a devotional term that emphasizes the leadership and excellence of the person being mentioned. For the Prophet Muhammad, Sayyiduna Muhammad is used to acknowledge his leadership over all believers, his status as the master of the children of Adam, and his role as the intercessor on the Day of Judgment. For the prominent companions, Sayyiduna Abu Bakr, Sayyiduna Umar, Sayyiduna Uthman, Sayyiduna Ali, and others, the title acknowledges their leadership of the early community and their service to Islam.

native_retrieval.snippet:
‘Sayyiduna’ Muhammad ﷺ—the Preeminent
Al-Maqasid
27600 subscribers
71 likes
1208 views
17 Mar 2022
“It’s just even a honor to be able to enunciate the name of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.”

On October 16, 2021, Al-Maqasid held its Annual Loving the Beloved ﷺ, commemorating the life of the Prophet Muhammad ). This series includes ten short, but immensely beneficial, lessons shared that evening that seek to illuminate the heart and nurture one’s love for Allah the Exalted and His Messenger ﷺ.
 
Quoting several Hadith, Sh. Walead Mosaad emphasizes the significance and propriety of referring to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as ‘Sayyid’ (which can be translated as ‘Master’). Sh. Walead also provides proof from the Quran that the Prophet’s innate nature ﷺ was mercy and reminds us that his Prophethood ﷺ transcends his humanity and earthly existence.
